mtlx check.summary: Run selected document checks on one or more .mtlx or .mtlx.zip files (glob patterns accepted)

flags.name: strict
flags.summary: Fail on warnings as well as errors

flags.name: rules

flags.name: format
flags.summary: Output format

flags.name: name
flags.summary: Material name (alternative to <user>/<name>)

flags.name: output
flags.summary: Output file path (defaults to the material name)

flags.name: user
flags.summary: User name

mtlx info.summary: Print information about a .mtlx or .mtlx.zip file

flags.name: format
flags.summary: Output format

flags.name: token
flags.summary: Secret API token (st_...) for service account authentication

flags.name: host
flags.summary: API host URL (overrides config)

mtlx mcp.summary: Run a Model Context Protocol server over stdio (check, inspect, render, and edit tools for AI agents)

mtlx nodes.summary: Search MaterialX node definitions: exact names, inputs with defaults, and preview-renderer notes

args.name: query
args.summary: Substring of the definition name, category, or node group; comma-separate several (e.g. worley,smoothstep,fract)

flags.name: limit
flags.summary: Maximum definitions to list

flags.name: format
flags.summary: Output format

mtlx render.summary: Render a .mtlx or .mtlx.zip file to a PNG image using a local headless browser

flags.name: output
flags.summary: PNG file to write. With several --view, a .png path gets a contact sheet; any other path (or an existing directory, or one ending in /) gets <view>.png files

flags.name: view
flags.summary: Named views rendered in one browser session: plane, closeup, detail, grazing, sphere, totem, cube, or plane:<meters> for a head-on plane of that width (1 UV = 1 m)

flags.name: geometry
flags.summary: Preview geometry

flags.name: material
flags.summary: Material name (default: last material in the document)

flags.name: background
flags.summary: Backdrop behind the model; none keeps the IBL lighting but leaves the PNG transparent

flags.name: size
flags.summary: Image width and height in pixels

flags.name: ibl
flags.summary: Lighting: studio (soft, dim room), bridge (outdoor, shows relief, green-yellow cast), sun (hard midday sun, strongest relief), overcast (soft medium daylight, near neutral), neutral (colorless grey studio, for judging albedo), strips (dark room with sharp softbox strips, for judging gloss and roughness breakup), dusk (warm, medium-dark street), night (very dark)

flags.name: exposure
flags.summary: Exposure in stops (-2..2)

flags.name: zoom
flags.summary: Camera zoom factor for close-ups (1 = default framing)

flags.name: elevation
flags.summary: Camera elevation in degrees (default 35; 0 = head-on to the plane)

flags.name: center
flags.summary: UV point the plane view aims at, e.g. 0.25,0.7

flags.name: supersample
flags.summary: Render at 2x and downsample (smoother thin features)

flags.name: channel
flags.summary: Show one nodegraph node unlit (floats grey, vectors as rgb) and print its value statistics

flags.name: uv-scale
flags.summary: Multiply every texcoord by N, so the 1 m plane shows N × N m (layout checks over several meters)

flags.name: grid
flags.summary: Overlay UV grid lines every N meters (with labels) on head-on plane views, e.g. 0.1

flags.name: crop
flags.summary: Crop x,y,size pixels of each view and enlarge it to --size (nearest neighbour) for pixel-level inspection

flags.name: mirror
flags.summary: Print how symmetric each head-on plane view is about a UV line, e.g. u=0.15 or v=0.5 (book-match checks)

flags.name: range
flags.summary: Value range mapped to black..white for --channel, e.g. -0.003,0.002 (default 0,1)

flags.name: browser
flags.summary: Chromium-based browser executable (default: installed Chrome, Edge, or Playwright Chromium)

flags.name: timeout
flags.summary: Seconds to wait for the material to compile and each view to render

mtlx transform.summary: Convert, combine, or resize/reformat textures across one or more .mtlx / .mtlx.zip files (glob patterns accepted), writing --output. A directory --output batch-converts each input separately instead of combining.

flags.name: output
flags.summary: Output path; a .mtlx/.mtlx.zip path combines every input into one file, a directory converts each input separately (same basename, same format) into that directory

flags.name: verbose
flags.summary: Batch mode: print every file written instead of just a one-line summary

flags.name: dry-run
flags.summary: Transform and validate in memory, report planned files, and create no output

flags.name: profile
flags.summary: Apply a named texture preset (e.g. "web": webp-preferred, 2048px max, EXRs normalized to PIZ); only touches incompatible textures

flags.name: max-image-size
flags.summary: Resize any texture whose longest edge exceeds this many pixels; overrides --profile

flags.name: image-format
flags.summary: Comma-separated target formats (webp,png,jpg,avif,exr,hdr); overrides --profile. Each source converts to the target sharing its dynamic range: SDR sources use the first SDR target, HDR sources (exr/hdr) use the first HDR target. An HDR source with no HDR target requested is linearly clipped to SDR (no tone mapping). Append ":<compression>" to exr (e.g. "exr:piz") to normalize EXR compression; supported: none, rle, zips, zip, piz, pxr24, b44, b44a, dwaa, dwab

flags.name: image-quality
flags.summary: Quality for lossy image formats (webp/jpg/avif)

flags.name: texture-library
flags.summary: Loose .mtlx output only: copy textures into this directory (relative to --output) instead of ./textures. Ignored for .mtlx.zip output, whose resources remain inside the archive.

flags.name: format
flags.summary: Output format
